subject: FINDING: OPEN_INNER is topology-ready, not native-inner-frame-ready
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-display-rd-opening-terminal-inner-handoff-20261001t230701z. Source-confirmed against main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e: Fold7ContinuityController enters OPEN_INNER when angle>=172 deg + topology.innerActive. Fold7ContinuityCoordinator defines innerActive as inner Display.state != OFF && != UNKNOWN. FoldOverlayService then clears earlyOpeningVisualLatched for any state outside OPENING_FROM_CLOSED/INNER_HANDOFF, and Fold7CoverRenderPolicy stops runEarlyOpeningVisual; PanelEngine.endContinuityOpeningVisual removes the cover overlay. No current-cycle native-inner first-frame/content-ready evidence gates that terminal release. Independently, PanelEngine's afterSwap path explicitly says a freshly switched-on panel may still be lighting up and retries captures when black, so current source itself distinguishes route/display activation from usable inner pixels. Android's Display API only defines STATE_ON as display on; Accessibility ScreenshotResult provides an exact screenshot timestamp, giving an existing source of stronger per-attempt evidence. Reduced baseline reproduces release-without-evidence. Proposed Gen2 terminal owner separates controller OPEN_INNER intent from cover-visual release and accepts only serviceEpoch+openCycleId+routeEpoch+attemptSequence current inner evidence; remap/reversal/stale evidence are fenced. Cover-route loss and the existing bounded watchdog remain explicit degraded releases, never readiness success. Corrected adversarial model PASS=16/16 including 100,000 fixed-seed operations. Initial model flaw found/fixed: terminal release must end the owner cycle so post-release remap cannot mutate completed evidence. This is an architectural source gap, not yet claimed as a physically observed Fold7 glitch; device validation required.
